import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[][] fireDist = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] exitDist = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] cellId = new int[150][150];
    static int N, Tmax;
    static String[] cells, caps;

    static class FlowEdge {
        int from, to;
        long capacity, flow;

        FlowEdge(int f, int t, long c) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            capacity = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlowSolver {
        int nodes, src, dst;
        List<FlowEdge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] level, current;
        Queue<Integer> q;

        MaxFlowSolver(int n, int s, int d) {
            nodes = n;
            src = s;
            dst = d;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            current = new int[n];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, 0));
            adj.get(u).add(edges.size() - 2);
            adj.get(v).add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean levelGraph() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[src] = 0;
            q.offer(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int idx : adj.get(u)) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges.get(idx);
                    if (e.capacity - e.flow > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[dst] != -1;
        }

        long augment(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == dst) return flow;
            for (int i = current[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                current[u] = i;
                int idx = adj.get(u).get(i);
                FlowEdge e = edges.get(idx);
                if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.capacity - e.flow > 0) {
                    long pushed = augment(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long solve() {
            long result = 0;
            while (levelGraph()) {
                Arrays.fill(current, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = augment(src, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    result += pushed;
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static List<int[]> getNeighbors(int r, int c) {
        List<int[]> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (r + 1 < N) res.add(new int[]{r + 1, c});
        if (r - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r - 1, c});
        if (c + 1 < N) res.add(new int[]{r, c + 1});
        if (c - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r, c - 1});
        return res;
    }

    static void propagateFire(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(fireDist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        fireDist[sr][sc] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int[] neighbor : getNeighbors(r, c)) {
                int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                char ch = cells[nr].charAt(nc);
                if ((ch != 'Z' && !Character.isDigit(ch)) || fireDist[nr][nc] != -1) continue;
                fireDist[nr][nc] = fireDist[r][c] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(cells[i].charAt(j)) && fireDist[i][j] == -1) {
                    fireDist[i][j] = Tmax;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void propagateExit(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(exitDist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        exitDist[sr][sc] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int[] neighbor : getNeighbors(r, c)) {
                int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                if (!Character.isDigit(cells[nr].charAt(nc)) || exitDist[nr][nc] != -1) continue;
                exitDist[nr][nc] = exitDist[r][c] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Tmax = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        cells = new String[N];
        caps = new String[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            cells[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            caps[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        int fireR = -1, fireC = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                cellId[i][j] = i * N + j + 1;
                if (cells[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    fireR = i;
                    fireC = j;
                }
            }
        }

        propagateFire(fireR, fireC);

        int totalNodes = 2 * N * N + 2;
        MaxFlowSolver solver = new MaxFlowSolver(totalNodes, 0, totalNodes - 1);
        solver.edges = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(cells[i].charAt(j))) {
                    int people = cells[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    solver.connect(0, cellId[i][j], people);
                    propagateExit(i, j);
                    for (int r = 0; r < N; r++) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < N; c++) {
                            if (Character.isDigit(caps[r].charAt(c)) && exitDist[r][c] != -1 &&
                                exitDist[r][c] <= fireDist[r][c] && exitDist[r][c] <= Tmax) {
                                boolean ok = true;
                                if (exitDist[r][c] == fireDist[r][c]) {
                                    ok = false;
                                    for (int[] neighbor : getNeighbors(r, c)) {
                                        int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                                        if (exitDist[nr][nc] != -1 &&
                                            exitDist[nr][nc] < fireDist[nr][nc]) {
                                            ok = true;
                                            break;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (ok) {
                                    solver.connect(cellId[i][j], N * N + cellId[r][c], people);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(caps[i].charAt(j))) {
                    int cap = caps[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    solver.connect(N * N + cellId[i][j], totalNodes - 1, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solver.solve());
    }
}
